fix: In 'a-b[-c]' the number in square brackets is a rare extreme value. It should go in value_max_extreme, not replace the normal maximum b. Read it the same way as '(-c)'.
reason: The flora gives a blade width of 0.3-0.6 cm, rarely up to 1.2 cm. The annotation records the range as 0.3-1.2 and loses the normal maximum of 0.6.
In the lexicon, 'apiculate' is a synonym of sharpness (PATO_0000944). The negation applies to the anthers, as the flora says.
The male flowers have 3 stamens. The statement sits inside the male-flower description, but the female flower has no stamens, so the count is not false.
The stems are strigulose when young (PATO_0000309 young) and become glabrate with age.
The pedicels are more or less pilose, and the 'approximately' qualifier captures the ±.
'Dichasium' is a synonym of cyme inflorescence (PO_0030126). Compound dichasia are present, in the leaf axils.
The leaves are glabrous when mature (PATO_0001701 mature).
'Stout' rhizomes means thick rhizomes. 'Long' would be a separate annotation.

target: position: base (proximal region) of the fruit
fix: In 'with truncate base' the shape belongs to the base of the named organ, not the whole organ. Fill the position slot with base/proximal, as for 'base truncate'.
reason: Only the base of the capsule is truncate, not the whole fruit.
The stems are greyish-green (PATO_0104007).
The stipules are fused to the petiole bases. 'Petiole base' is a synonym of petiole proximal end (PO_0008024).

target: leaf margin: serrate (PATO_0001206), continuum to lobed
fix: In 'obtuse-serrate' (and 'incised-lobed') the first word describes the teeth of the second, so it is one value, not a range between two values. Read the head word (serrate, lobed) as the value and use the margin as the bearer.
reason: The flora describes the leaf margin as serrate with blunt teeth, grading to incised-lobed. The annotation reads it as a range from obtuse to serrate on the leaf blade.
The lower (abaxial) surface of the blade is sparsely puberulent. Swapping in the abaxial epidermis as the bearer is right.

fix: A 'bud' inside the flower description, just before 'Corolla', is a flower bud.
reason: In Loranthaceae, the mature bud measured here is the flower bud just before opening, not a vegetative bud.

target: position: upper (cauline) leaves of the flowering stem; value puberulous (FLOPO_0991049)
fix: In French '<organe> supérieures de la tige florifère ..., <adjectif>', the adjective belongs only to that subset of leaves. Carry the position/whole into the context slot.
reason: The other leaves are tomentose. Only the upper leaves of the flowering stem are puberulent, so 'leaves pubescent' as stated is false for the plant.

target: place: inner (adaxial) surface of the claw of the standard
fix: 'à l'intérieur' / 'inside' names the inner face. Fill the place slot (adaxial side) instead of dropping it.
reason: The claw of the standard is tomentose only on its inner side. The bearer (stalk within banner petal) is right, but without the place the statement claims the whole claw is tomentose.
The ovary is ovoid-globose, a shape between ovoid and globose, under convex 3-D shape. Reading it as a continuum is acceptable.
The leaf blades are 'not stiff', and the negated inflexible (PATO_0001545) matches.

target: wing of the fruit (lateral wings of the samara)
fix: In samara descriptions, 'wings' and 'lateral wings' are parts of the fruit. Use the wing as the bearer (with the fruit as the whole), not the fruit itself.
reason: The linear-lanceolate shape belongs to the lateral wings. The fruit body is not lanceolate.
The calyx is 1.3-2.4 cm long at flowering. The size in fruit is given separately.
The rhizome is not white-waxy, and the negated waxy matches.

fix: 'Male flowers' maps to staminate flower, which is in PO with the synonym 'male flower'.
reason: Only the male flowers are short-pedicellate or sessile. The female flowers are described separately.

fix: An OCR split of a number ('1 1-13' for '11-13') gives a false lower bound. Join a single digit followed by a space and a range when they come before '-flowered'. The whole slot should be the head (capitulum).
reason: The heads are 11-13-flowered, not 1-13.

fix: For a whole plant given as 'a × b', the first number is the height and the second the width (spread). The numbers chosen here are the second dimension, so the quality is width; the height is 4-10 cm.
reason: 5-15(-20) cm is the spread of the mat, not its length or height.

fix: In 'X of Y', Y is the whole that X belongs to. Keep Y in the whole slot.
reason: Only the prickles on the follicles are pilose when mature. Zanthoxylum also has stem prickles, so without 'of follicles' the statement is too broad.

fix: 'Albumen' (French and older English) means endosperm. It is a synonym in PO, so it should not fall back to the seed.
reason: The endosperm is horny (hard), not the whole seed.
The faces of the seed are not ornamented. Using the seed (its surface) as the bearer is acceptable.
The inner sepals are 4-5 mm wide, and the context 'inner' (FLOPO_0991378) is set.
The branchlets are pubescent when young. The hair colour (white) is a separate statement.
There are numerous seeds: seeds present, amount 'many'.
